segments.contextBefore: The SwiftUI `ForEach` structure computes views for each element of the `Flavor` enumeration and extracts the raw value of each of its elements using the resulting text to create each list row item.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct ContentView: View { enum Flavor: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable { var id: String { self.rawValue } case vanilla, chocolate, strawberry } var body: some View { List { ForEach(Flavor.allCases) { Text($0.rawValue) .listRowBackground(Ellipse() .background(Color.clear) .foregroundColor(.purple) .opacity(0.3) ) } } } } ```
segments.contextBefore: The `listRowBackground(_:)` modifier then places the view you supply behind each of the list row items:
